criteria.description: Covers the core UI states beyond the happy path — at minimum empty, loading/in-progress, error, and success — as designed states.
Includes states specific to file upload — e.g. drag-over/hover, per-file upload progress, upload failure/retry, invalid file type or too-large, partial-success of a multi-file upload.
For each state, says what the user can do / how to recover (e.g. retry a failed upload, remove a file), not just the visual.
Addresses data extremes (0 files, 1, many, very long filenames) so the layout stays intentional.
Treats the empty state as informative (not blank) and errors as recoverable (clear message + next step), not dead ends or raw errors.
